known_limitations: A single learning rate is shared across algorithms, so this is a controlled comparison rather than a hyperparameter search.
The objectives are small teaching problems; rankings do not imply universal superiority.
Wall-clock time is not reported because the implementations and hardware vary.
name: optimizer_comparison

objective_descriptions.logistic: Logistic regression on a standardized two-moons split. Parameters are [w₁, w₂, b]; this is a 3-D objective, so only loss curves are plotted.
objective_descriptions.quadratic: Axis-aligned quadratic with curvature 1 and 10; the narrow valley exposes the effect of momentum and adaptive scaling.
objective_descriptions.rosenbrock: Rosenbrock's banana-shaped valley; a non-convex objective with a global minimum at (1, 1).
